name: Itsuwari ~Ingyaku no Bijin Shimai~
original_name: いつわり～淫虐の美人姉妹～
source:
Main character is a powerful conglomerate heir, but lives a modest life with his twin sister. One day he receives a task from his father to enslave and train half-sisters who are also group successors able to lay claims and pose problems in future.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是实力雄厚的企业继承人，却与孪生妹妹过着朴素的生活。有一天，他接到父亲的一项任务，要奴役和训练同父异母的姐妹，她们也是集团的继承人，能够在未来提出主张并提出问题。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
